description: This PHP source file defines the SaveLeaveTypeController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It handles pre-render logic for leave type views, determining whether to load an edit or save component based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the HTTP request.

classes.name: SaveLeaveTypeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the view component for creating or editing leave types, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the appropriate Vue component ('leave-type-edit' or 'leave-type-save') depending on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
